info.title: SBIR / STTR Phase I-III Commercialization Plan API
info.description: Stateless AI R&D Proposal & IP Compliance API that converts R&D technical specifications and SBIR/STTR solicitation topics into a DoD/AFWERX/SpaceWERX/NSF/NASA SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL 19 progression matrix, Phase III Dual-Use Commercialization & Transition Plan (15 U.S.C.  638(r)(4)), and pre-award DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR Data Rights assertions.

post.description: Converts R&D specs and an SBIR/STTR topic description into a DoD/AFWERX/NSF SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL 1–9 progression matrix, Phase III Dual-Use Commercialization & Transition Plan, and DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR Data Rights assertions.

sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs.description: Full or excerpted DoD, AFWERX, SPACEWERX, Navy, Army, DARPA, NSF, NASA, or DHS SBIR/STTR topic instructions, Phase I/II/III technical objectives, and evaluation criteria.

company_technology_and_ip_baseline.description: Summary of the small business offeror's R&D technology, current TRL, Principal Investigator (PI) credentials, prior IRAD/patents, STTR university/lab partner (if applicable), and dual-use commercial traction.

sponsoring_agency.description: Optional sponsoring federal agency or SBIR/STTR directorate.

example.sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs: Solicitation: AF262-D014 (Direct-to-Phase II AFWERX / SpaceWERX Open Topic). Objective: Develop and demonstrate an autonomous edge-AI tactical spectrum sensing and anti-jamming cognitive radio waveform for contested C5ISR environments. Must demonstrate TRL 6 prototype in relevant tactical environment within 15 months, include a signed Phase III Customer Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) pathway with PEO C3BM, and provide a dual-use commercialization strategy alongside a DFARS 252.227-7018 SBIR Data Rights schedule.
example.company_technology_and_ip_baseline: AegisWave Photonics & AI Lab (Small Business, 42 employees) has developed a proprietary sub-millisecond neural blind-signal classifier and FPGA cognitive frequency-hopping core tested at TRL 4 in laboratory anechoic trials using $1.8M in private seed venture capital. Commercial dual-use market includes 5G/6G private industrial wireless interference mitigation and low-Earth-orbit (LEO) commercial satcom ground terminals.
example.sponsoring_agency: Department of Defense (AFWERX / SpaceWERX / PEO C3BM)

200.description: Successfully generated SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL Matrix, Commercialization Plan & DFARS 252.227-7018 Data Rights.
